divOfScalarTimesVector/1a-divPerp/twoGau.cause: Expected property of the scheme, not a bug: Div(f) holds a (1/J) d(J f_x)/dx term; at the first cell next to the axis the 1/J (x = dx/2) multiplies the second-order error of the centred derivative, so the error of that cell falls as dx. Away from the axis (x >= 1) the order is 2, reproduced in a Python replica of the stencil.

divOfScalarTimesVector/2a-divSource/twoG.cause: Bug in the case: the run crashes (segmentation fault) at every resolution. divSource.cxx declares ownOp and never creates it, and div_f_GradPerp_g reads its members J and J2 through that pointer. The probable fix is a call ownOp = OwnOperators::createOperators(); in init(), not tried because it changes guarded C++. The crash is read from the code and the CI log, not reproduced under a debugger. No order is known until it runs.

Away from the axis (x >= 1) the order is 2, reproduced in a Python replica of the stencil.
